answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 59 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 15 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 59 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 440 sponsors, each risking real money. A kernel of doubt is healthy, a nebula of proof is required, and a anchor of patience is the price of a clean panel.
